title: EASy Work
tagline: EasyWork is your go-to trusted space where you can easily confirm your work experiences and payments.
description: EasyWork is your go-to trusted space where you can easily confirm your work experiences and payments. We're all about creating a clear and fair environment for freelancers and job providers. It's a place where you can confidently vouch for what you've done and what you've earned – making the whole process straightforward and trustworthy for everyone involved.
how_its_made:
Our website's front end is built using ENS's cool framework called Thorin. We also use Ethereum Attestation Service to handle attestations for job givers and freelancers. Job givers can confirm that freelancers did the work and what kind of project it was. Freelancers can say if the job giver was fair and kept their end of the deal.

Once a job is done, and the job giver confirms it, our Resolver contract automatically pays the freelancer the amount mentioned in the job attestation. We tweaked the Resolver contract to make it work smoothly with our cool dApp.

And guess what? We've got these contracts up and running on both Linea and Arbitrum testnets, making things easy and flexible for everyone!
